children: Call it Google deja vu. Amazon's miss in its key advertising business was eerily reminiscent of Google's stumble a day earlier on slowing revenue growth from search advertising. Growth in Amazon's ad business decelerated to 12% year-over-year from 26% y/y last quarter. "The advertising miss is likely to reignite questions around agentic commerce and whether AI-driven discovery is beginning to pressure an important profit pool," Bernstein analysts say in a note. But the analysts also say Amazon is pushing back on suggestions that changing consumer behavior is impacting advertising demand. "Management's view is that AI shopping experiences remain nascent, offer an inferior shopping experience in many cases today, and are nowhere near replacing the convenience, selection, and one-click purchase journey offered by large retail platforms," Bernstein says. (patrick.sheridan@wsj.com)
